rootCauses.summary: NightView.build synchronously generates 100 procedural forest trees and 130 edge props even at the 673px mobile observation viewport.
rootCauses.prediction: A viewport-bound decorative budget reduces mobile synchronous world-generation work while preserving full desktop density and all gameplay entities/rules.
rootCauses.falsifier: Mobile still receives the full decorative counts or immutable After shows no improvement in hunt-entry long-task/frame metrics.

observation.summary: On merged immutable staging, first-hunt entry retained a severe synchronous stall: browser evidence recorded p95 1150ms, an 18119ms long task around hunt entry, and immediate staged fps of 1. Source shows decorative world generation uses fixed desktop-scale counts on the 673px viewport.

evidence.statement: p95 1150ms; max hunt-entry long task 18119ms; staged snapshot fps 1.
Decorative forest and edge loops use fixed counts 100 and 130 independent of viewport.

hypothesis.cause: Mobile hunt entry pays desktop decorative generation cost synchronously before play can settle.
hypothesis.prediction: Reducing only decorative density on compact viewports lowers entry blocking while preserving gameplay geometry, NPCs, Tidebreak and saves.
hypothesis.falsifier: Focused budget test fails or immutable After long-task/frame metrics do not improve.

candidates.reason: Cuts only decorative generation work and preserves full desktop density.
Would damage the authored visual identity instead of scaling it.

implementation.summary: Add a pure viewport detail budget and use it only for decorative forest/edge counts.

limitations: Portable balance probe does not cover rendering cost.
Hosted Chromium timing is directional, not a physical Pixel Fold benchmark.
